lines: His is one kaulic visarga-power, by which,
from bliss-form to the end of outward creation,
throbbing, the class-contemplations and the rest
outward have attained the form of tattvas.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tasya ca ekaiva kaulikī visargaśaktiḥ yayā ānandarūpāt prabhṛti iyatā bahiḥsṛṣṭiparyantena praspandataḥ vargādiparāmarśā eva bahis tattvarūpatāṃ prāptāḥ

reads_against.argmap: How does kaulikī visarga-śakti produce the tattvas? → One kaulic visarga-throb externalizes the varga-parāmarśas into standing tattvas: emanation is visarga-driven.
c1_essence: One kaulic visarga-throb externalizes the class-contemplations into tattva-forms.
